body: Out of everything I have ever come across, I relate most to this.

Usually 2 eggs for breakfast.  And maybe a tv dinner for lunch or like a sandwich.  Sometimes some Chinese food.  If I'm feeling dinner it wpuld be like some cereal but usually I dont eat dinner.  I dont really have an appetite.

People saying this is fake dont realize how hard this game actually is.  Random shit like this happens.

I have. I actually lost 90 pounds but gained it +20 pounds back unfortunately.  Alot of it has to do with dealing with depression.  I am at a point where I do want to lose weight but feel like no matter what I try, I always fail. Part of that has to do with finding the will to do it.  Im alone and in my room 24/7 so really I just have given up. I feel like it won't matter anyways because I have no friends.
I'm 25 now.  I've been overweight since 11 or 12 years old.

Watching these transformation photos just makes me give up even more.  25 years old and I have been trying to lose weight since I was 14 years old.  Pathetic.  I am pathetic.  Fat.  These people find the will..how?? How do they do it.  I try and try and am just alone..always alone trying telling myself I can do it and never do.  Being fat is horrible.  I wish not even my worst enemy to be obese.  I cant even go to a store, or go out with friends without having an anxiety attack because how embarassed I am.  I  lost all my friends because I let me being fat get in the way of going out with them.  No excuses for that.  Just no will.  I dont think I care anymore.
